name: Apron
what: Invoice and supplier-payment automation for small businesses and their accountants.

membership.basis: Live visionaries.vc portfolio; named an existing investor in the Series A.
membership.quote: existing investors Bessemer Venture Partners and Visionaries Club

entry.quote: In June, Apron raised $5.5m (£4.5m) in a Bessemer Venture Partners-led seed round.

graduation.quote: The Series A round was led by Index Ventures

notes: Entry = the $5.5M (GBP 4.5M) Bessemer-led seed of June 2023, medium confidence. UKTN (2023-09-28) names that seed ('In June, Apron raised $5.5m ... Bessemer Venture Partners-led seed round') and in the same piece calls Visionaries Club an EXISTING investor at the $15M Series A three months later; that seed is the only earlier round on record. Nordic9's deal note (investor-intel site, treat as vendor) is headlined 'Apron raised $5.5M in a seed funding round led by Bessemer Venture Partners, joined by Visionaries Club'. FinSMEs (2023-06-13, read via Wayback) names only Bessemer plus angels (Melio and Klarna founders), and Business Insider dates the seed 'from July'. Graduation: Series A $15M led by Index Ventures, with Bessemer and Visionaries Club (tech.eu, UKTN, Finextra, BusinessCloud, 2023-09-28). Series B: $30M led by Zinal Growth (Financial IT copy of the company release, 2024-09-25), with existing investors Index and Bessemer and Tony Fadell; Visionaries is not named in the B (firm_in_round false on that list). Founded 2021 (UKTN) by ex-Revolut product lead Bogdan Uzbekov. No priced valuation found; no later round (Google News to 2026-09).
